‘vivAde pfcCati praSnaM pratipannaM taTEva ca । priyapUrvvaM prAgvadati prAqvivAkastataH smftaH ॥’ vastutastu prAqvivAkasamAKyAmAha kAtyAyanaH । ‘vyavahArASritaM praSnaM pfcCati prAqiti sTitiH । aNgAni parivAradevatAH । ‘indraM pUrvve tu saMsTApya preteSaM dakziRe taTA । varuRaM paScime BAge kuveraM uttare taTA ॥ agnyAdilokapAlAMSca koRaBAgezu vinyaset ॥ * ॥ indraH pIto yamaH SyAmo varuRaH
